initial_application_state: Two tenants; two users per tenant; owned Documents and attachments for each, including mismatched parent/child IDs.
required_inputs: Owner and same-tenant non-owner/cross-tenant read/write; list/count; nested mismatched attachment.
expected_outputs: Owner200; foreign/missing404; exact id/title and attachment id/name; lists/counts own-only.
forbidden_outputs: Secrets, traces, protected or foreign fields; schema deviations.
expected_side_effects: Only owner update persists; reads produce none.
forbidden_side_effects: Foreign data/count leakage, unrelated child access, denied mutation.
required_security_behavior: Actual configured authentication and server-side authorization, safe output, unchanged denied state.
Security Reviewer clearance required; no implementation author may provide it.

required_tests.requirement: Deny same-tenant non-owner and cross-tenant reads/writes.
Lists/counts and nested mismatches disclose no foreign data.
Owner controls succeed; denied writes preserve all documents.

independent_verification_checks: Reviewer freezes executable assertions, adapter and fixture bytes before implementation.
Reviewer independently reruns clean candidate and relevant mutations; reads DB/response evidence, not implementer claims.
Hash candidate before/after variants; rerun clean candidate; verify criterion coverage and regression results.
Owner PATCH uses a changed title; fresh DB read and response must match; unrelated rows and all denied-write snapshots remain unchanged.

fault_variants.mutation: Remove owner predicate; retain tenant predicate
fault_variants.isolation: New disposable copy per fault; no clean-source overwrite; hash mutation and unchanged tests.
fault_variants.detection: Relevant assertion failure with zero infrastructure errors; clean baseline and rerun PASS.
